name: Incanto
description: A fully responsive e-commerce website featuring a shopping cart with product management. It includes a mock Paystack payment integration for a real-world feel. Users can browse products, add them to their cart, and go through a smooth checkout process.

name: Veerge
description: A real estate management platform that helps property developers and companies manage listings, customer relationships, sales processes, and business operations. I actively contributed to the frontend development, building responsive interfaces, implementing reusable components, and integrating frontend features using Next.js, Chakra UI, and React Query.

name: Expert Listing
description: A real estate marketplace that provides verified property listings for buyers and renters, connecting them with property owners, developers, and agents. I worked as part of the frontend team, contributing to the development of user interfaces, feature implementation, and ensuring a smooth and responsive user experience.

name: KreateSell
description: KreateSell is a user-friendly, all-in-one e-commerce platform designed especially for creators, entrepreneurs, and content producers—particularly across Africa—who want to sell digital products globally with ease.

name: Modiba Solutions
description: I worked on the frontend of a service-based business website using React and Next.js. I turned the Figma designs into responsive, clean pages and made sure everything looked good on all devices. I also worked with a backend engineer to connect things like the contact form and dynamic sections to the API. The goal was to keep the site fast, user-friendly, and easy to navigate.

name: iKlass Tutors
description: iKlass Tutors is an nline platform that connects students and parents with verified, skilled tutors for both in-person and online learning. I worked alongside a team of devlopers to create the interface along with implemen its core feature and functionlaities.

name: Myxellia Help Centre
description: A help centre platform designed to provide users with easy access to support resources and information. I contributed to building the frontend interface, creating responsive layouts, implementing reusable components, and ensuring a smooth user experience across different devices.

name: Task Organizer
description: A task management application built to demonstrate API integration and frontend state management. The app consumes external API data, displays tasks in a responsive layout, and includes features such as pagination, search, and filtering. It showcases my ability to work with APIs, manage application state, and create intuitive user experiences.
